results.title: Knowly — From Saved to Understood
results.content:
Title: Knowly — From Saved to Understood
# From saved to understood. Save anything, Knowly auto-organizes it, builds understanding of every source, and takes you to a personalized learning flow on demand. ## Save anything. A webpage, a PDF, a video, a tweet. One click on the Knowly bubble and it lands in your library — where Knowly instantly clusters it into topics you never had to create. ##### Your Library. ###### Consensus Protocols. ###### Distributed Storage. ###### Observability. ## Not a chatbot. A new way to learn, guided and fully proactive. Knowly gives you a Flow — a multi-page journey of pages it writes for you, each one built for your sources and your depth. Just what you came to understand. #### Flow. A guided, multi-page learning journey Knowly builds for you. #### GenPage. A page Knowly writes from your sources, for your depth. Click any blue word — a new page spawns on that topic, on the fly. ## And every webpage gets *two sides*. That's not all Knowly does. Open any page — article, paper, doc — and the bubble is right there. One click and the page flips: on the back is a version Knowly wrote for you. The page itself is the answer. ## An AI that *moves first*. A belief that shapes every surface of Knowly: a helpful AI agent doesn't wait to be asked. It reads what you save, watches what you return to, and proposes your next move — everywhere it lives. #### The next move surfaces itself. Recaps of what you've saved, cross-source connections, and the next step worth taking — surfaced before you land. #### The right digest, suggested. Knowly reads the page and proposes the digest that fits — skim, deep read, key points — before you pick. #### What's next, already answered. After every GenPage, Knowly offers where curiosity could go — compare, expand, switch topics, dive deeper. #### Explore around it. Every Source has a next step waiting — related reads, a quick digest, a Flow ready to kick off from it. A good agent doesn't. ## Start making sense of what you save. Knowly is in early access. Sign up and install the extension.

# Codex 3.0 by OpenAI Reviews

### The community submitted 102 reviews to tell us what they like about Codex 3.0 by OpenAI, what Codex 3.0 by OpenAI can do better, and more.

5.0

Based on 102 reviews

Review Codex 3.0 by OpenAI?

Reviewers describe Codex 3.0 as a strong autonomous coding tool that reads the real codebase, handles multi-file work, and can run tests before returning changes, making it especially useful for debugging, verification, and long, repo-wide tasks. Makers of MindPal, HarnessRouter, and Velo also say it is part of their build workflow. Main complaints are slower task speed, limited usage visibility, weak progress feedback, some context drift on large repos, and high memory use in long desktop sessions.
